**HPI**
Anthony Dimarcello is a 39 y.o. male who presents for evaluation of left shoulder pain, left chest pain, and right lower leg pain after being "slingshot" from his heavy E-bike about 24 hours ago. He states he was riding his E-bike along a dark path toward a large hill, pursued by 4 strangers on regular bicycles. He outrode his pursuers and attempted to turn to avoid striking the nearing hill but was moving too quickly. He attempted to slide, but his bike was too heavy and he was "slingshot" to the other side, landing on his left side on concrete. States his right lower leg was also wounded from his bike's spiked pedals but denies head trauma or LOC. States he smoked some marijuana following the accident with minimal relief. He currently reports intermittent dull left-sided chest pain and sharp, constant right lower leg pain with radiation to his ankle and up his shin. He also reports feeling "something swirling around" in his left lateral ribs beneath his left arm and states he has felt something in his left shoulder "rising up" throughout the day yesterday. States he felt a "pop" in his left upper back. He has been stretching his left shoulder but notes worsened lower left chest pain when moving his left arm. States his current pain is the worst he has ever experienced.
**PAST MEDICAL/SURGICAL HISTORY**
Patient denies any relevant past medical or surgical history.
